milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the white concrete powder structure and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The white concrete powder cluster is centered at spawn-relative (2, 1, 2) with a 3-block-tall pillar. Max distance of 16 blocks ensures the player is reasonably close, and facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking at the blocks (not just passing by). This is preferred over position_inside_box because 'find' tasks require visual confirmation, not just proximity.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange_concrete_powder drops the block as an item directly into the player's inventory (auto-pickup when nearby). The player starts with no orange_concrete_powder in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has is the most reliable and direct signal that the player both broke the block AND collected the drop.
